scope: Existing completed Grok TrustedSolve generated specification-solutions only
selection: All and only failed=false records; solves=false included unchanged. No selection on favorable outcomes.
source_row_hash_policy: SHA-256 of exact source JSONL row including original newline; source_record_index is zero-based.
solution_hash_policy: SHA-256 of exact native solution string encoded UTF-8; solution text unchanged.
omitted: All other source fields, especially calls, raw completions/reasoning/prompts, original candidate code and dataset inputs, are not exported.
failed_source_row_policy: The one failed source row remains in the previous outcome snapshot and local original; it has no completed solution in this addendum.
generated_solution_semantics: These are fresh solutions produced from specifications, not the original APPS honest/attack submissions. label/is_attack identify the associated source dataset record, not a new attack classification of this generated solution.
credential_and_private_user_path_scan: All exported solution strings checked; zero pattern matches. This is not a guarantee generated code is safe to execute.
